name: Trouble Makers
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid those who cause division and promote ungodliness, as seen in Psalms 1:1, which blesses the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked. Trouble makers often feed foolishness rather than seeking understanding, contrasting with the wise heart described in Proverbs 15:14. Jesus acknowledges that tribulation is inevitable in this world (John 16:33), yet encourages believers to remain steadfast because He has overcome the world. Titus 3:10 instructs the church to reject persistent heretics after repeated admonition, emphasizing the need for discernment and separation from those who disrupt the faith community.
